content:
iPhone Duo will officially go on sale by the end of the month, but Apple is reportedly set to unveil several more new products in October, with the first announcements coming as soon as next week. Here is a preview.

Apple Home upgrades coming with Siri AI

A long-awaited major update and expansion of Apple's Home product line is reportedly set to arrive on Tuesday, October 13.

The Apple Home upgrades are expected to centre on Siri AI and a range of Apple Intelligence features limited to new hardware. Here are the rumoured details:

  • All-new Apple TV 4K: A19 or A19 Pro chip, Siri AI, all-new Siri Remote
  • HomePad: A home hub with a built-in touchscreen display
  • HomePod mini 2: Stronger performance, improved sound and more

New Macs, including a redesigned premium MacBook Pro with a touchscreen

It's already been a banner year for the Mac: the MacBook Neo, the M5 MacBook Air, and the high-end M5 MacBook Pro all launched in the spring, followed more recently by the Mac mini and Mac Studio.

But Apple has more new models in the pipeline, including the company's first MacBook with a touchscreen. The three Macs being rumoured are:

  • All-new MacBook Pro/Ultra: A redesigned premium MacBook with a touchscreen, OLED display, and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: Updated specs for the 14-inch base-model MacBook Pro
  • M6 iMac: Stronger performance and new colour options

iPhone Duo and a new iPad mini

The iPhone Duo will officially reach customers this month. Pre-orders open October 16, with first deliveries on October 23. According to Bloomberg, an upgraded iPad mini is also expected to launch around the same time.

  • iPhone Duo: Apple's first foldable iPhone
  • New iPad mini: OLED display, A20 Pro chip, narrower bezels

Which October Apple product are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
